_doc: Copy to workers/registry.local.json (gitignored) on a machine where a worker's tool lives somewhere unusual, where a worker exists that should not be published, or where one *field* of a published worker needs a machine-specific value. The overlay merges by id over workers/registry.json, so an entry may carry only the fields it overrides. Keep absolute paths OUT of the published registry: the release checks reject machine-specific paths.

workers.notes: machine-local: the interpreter is installed here only
launch override: r-text is published with a portable `Rscript` launch; this machine has R installed off PATH, so only the launch is overridden here
